requestRefID.description: The unique request ID returned by the API for each request made

responseCode.description: A Numeric status code that indicates the status of the transaction submission. 200 means successful submission and any other code means an error occurred.

responseDesc.description: This is a message from the API that gives the status of the request processing and usually maps to a specific result code value.

lastSwapDate.description: This is a string representing the date in which the mobile number was last swapped. If the specified SIM was swapped more than 3 months ago, the API returns a default date of 01-01-1900
